source: The printer has jammed again.
The meeting ran over again.
rewrite: The meeting has, rather helpfully, run over again.

source: The report was submitted late.
rewrite: Naturally, the report was submitted late.

source: The forecast says rain for the picnic.
rewrite: Perfect picnic weather: the forecast says rain.

source: The attachment was missing again.
The software update broke the login screen.
rewrite: Brilliant update—the login screen no longer works. Excellent progress.

source: The train has been cancelled.
rewrite: Wonderful—the train has been cancelled. Perfect.

source: The kitchen has been left untidy.
rewrite: Lovely—the kitchen has been left untidy again, precisely as hoped.

source: The parcel arrived after the event.
rewrite: Oh, excellent—the parcel arrived after the event. Impeccable timing.

source: The internet stopped during the presentation.
rewrite: Oh, magnificent—the internet stopped during the presentation. What flawless timing.

source: The spreadsheet formula was overwritten.
rewrite: Oh, spectacular—the spreadsheet formula was overwritten. What masterful work.

source: You replied after the deadline.
rewrite: Oh, absolutely magnificent—you replied after the deadline. Truly, nothing says urgency like waiting until it was over.

source: The room was double-booked.
The email arrived a day late.
The lift is out of order.
You brought the wrong document.
The booking was cancelled.
The computer restarted during the call.
The coffee machine is broken again.
The deadline has moved again.
The presentation file would not open.
The delivery arrived at the wrong address.
The alarm went off after everyone arrived.
The latest version was not saved.
